config.noCharKey: {{name}}: no gcsim key (character not supported by gcsim, or a custom character)
config.noWeapon: {{name}}: no weapon set (calculated without a weapon)
config.weaponNotFound: {{name}}: weapon not found in the database
config.noWeaponKey: {{name}}: weapon "{{weapon}}" has no gcsim key (not supported by gcsim, or a custom weapon)
config.artifactNotFound: {{name}}: artifact set not found in the database
config.noArtifactKey: {{name}}: artifact "{{artifact}}" has no gcsim key (not supported by gcsim, or a custom artifact)
config.actionMissing: {{name}}: action "{{action}}" is not implemented in gcsim and cannot be run there (not included in the config; please remove the action)
config.noRule: {{name}}: action "{{action}}" ({{type}}) has no conversion rule for gcsim
config.plungeWarning: {{names}}: in gcsim, plunging attacks have prerequisites such as being airborne (the previous action), and may cause a run error if they are not met
config.chargeNeedsNormal: {{name}}: the action before "{{action}}" in stint #{{index}} is {{prev}}. gcsim needs a Normal Attack (N) right before a Charged Attack (in the game, holding produces the 1st normal hit and then the Charged Attack). Add N before this Charged Attack

plunge.airborne: airborne (e.g. right after a jump within 16 s of Xianyun's Burst)
plunge.afterJump: the previous action is a jump
plunge.afterBikeJump: right after a jump in the Nightsoul bike state (airborne also works)
plunge.afterCharged: the previous action is a Charged Attack (airborne also works)
plunge.afterFlight: right after the Elemental Skill's flight ends (after the Skill)
plunge.afterNightsoul: right after the Skill's Nightsoul state ends (after the Skill)
plunge.afterTapSkill: the previous action is a tapped Elemental Skill
plunge.afterHoldSkill: the previous action is a held Elemental Skill (airborne also works)
plunge.afterSkill: the previous action is an Elemental Skill (airborne also works)
plunge.afterLeapSkill: the previous action is an Elemental Skill (during the leap state; airborne also works)
plunge.noPrev: none (start of the stint, or right after a wait or switch)
plunge.message: In gcsim, {{kind}} causes a run error unless "{{needs}}" (previous action: {{prev}})
plunge.title: {{name}}: plunging attack prerequisite

rotation.gcsimMissingAction: This action is not implemented in gcsim. Running it in gcsim causes an error, so it cannot be included in the config
rotation.noNightsoulBurst: Nightsoul Burst only occurs when the team has a Natlan character. This team has none
rotation.nightsoulInterval: "{{action}}" needs {{remaining}} more seconds after the previous Nightsoul Burst ({{count}} Natlan characters in the team → once every {{interval}} s)
rotation.swapCd: The stint is {{seconds}} s long. That is a quick switch, close to Genshin's internal switch cooldown (about 1.0 s).
rotation.modeNotEndedHold: "{{mode}}" must be ended before switching ({{remaining}} s left). Place an action that ends it (e.g. pressing E again) before the switch (gcsim cannot switch and stops)
rotation.modeNotEnded: "{{mode}}" must be ended before switching ({{remaining}} s left). Place an action that ends it, or turn on "Mode hold" for this stint
rotation.blockedTitle: {{name}}: action not allowed during the mode
rotation.blockedWait: gcsim waits until {{mode}} ends ({{seconds}} s left)
rotation.blockedNone: Nothing happens in the game; gcsim runs it as a different action

action.normal: Normal Attack. Used consecutively, it advances through hit 1, hit 2, … (another action in between resets it to hit 1).
action.charged: Charged Attack. Consumes stamina (Aimed Shot for bows, Charged Attack for catalysts).
action.plunge_low: Plunging Attack (low). Falls from a low position and deals AoE DMG on landing.
action.plunge_high: Plunging Attack (high). Falls from a high position and deals AoE DMG on landing.
action.swap: Switch. The time of the switch motion.
action.modeHold: Hold. A wait that extends the stint so the mode (state) lasts its maximum duration.

buff.outOfScope: gcsim has no state key for this (or does not support it), so it is not placed by gcsim results. Shown only when placed manually
buff.revelationNote: gcsim does not implement Revelation, so it is not placed by gcsim results. Shown only when placed manually
